counting_rules.denominator: Question-worthy entries only: question_suitable == yes (143). Excluded: 17 NOT_QUESTION_WORTHY (16 unsuitable incl. Minor-reference + 1 REVIEW_REQUIRED timeline entry counted separately, not in any denominator).
counting_rules.covered_definition: COVERED only when at least one FINAL, VALID question genuinely tests the entry. Distractor mention, explanation mention, and invalid questions (Q-P3-003) do not count.
counting_rules.partially_definition: PARTIALLY_COVERED when a valid final question tests only part of the entry or with a context defect (INV-3-067: alignment tested, tower half only a distractor; stem lacks "of a temple").
counting_rules.candidate_caveat: candidate_status counts any candidate referencing the entry fact (tested or distractor role). For non-final candidates the two roles cannot be separated in production metrics; final-question tested facts are exact (evidence_fact_ids).
counting_rules.extraction_aggregation: Worst matrix classification among items referencing the entry (severity: NOT_EXTRACTED/VISUAL_ONLY > CORRUPTION > INCOMPLETE > REVIEW_REQUIRED > FAITHFUL). Matrix unit is a source item (126 items), inventory unit is a learning point (160 entries); counts therefore differ by design.
counting_rules.representation_rule: TYPED = a non-fallback fact faithfully expresses the entry; TYPED_CORRUPTED = typed fact exists but subject/object is a fragment, pronoun, figure reference, merge, or truncation; FALLBACK_ONLY = prose reached the fact layer only as an unclassified unit; NO_FACT = nothing extracted.
